title: RecSoup: Efficient Model Merging Approach for Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21220v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recommender systems often need to balance multiple conflicting objectives. Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation (CMOR) enables dynamic adjustment of objective trade-offs at inference time without retraining, adapting to shifting user or system requirements. Existing CMOR approaches typically rely on output-level reranking or parameter-generating modules, which either limit the scope of feasible trade-offs or incur substantial training and inference cost. Model merging provides a promising alternative by reusing multiple objective-specific models via parameter combination. However, its direct application to recommender systems is challenging due to the lack of a shared linear regime and cross-objective interference. To address these issues, we propose RecSoup, a lightweight two-stage approach for effective CMOR via specialized model merging. translated_title: RecSoup：一种面向可控多目标推荐的高效模型合并方法
translated_abstract: 推荐系统通常需要平衡多个相互冲突的目标。可控多目标推荐（CMOR）能够在推理阶段动态调整目标间的权衡，而无需重新训练，从而适应不断变化的用户或系统需求。现有的CMOR方法通常依赖于输出层的重排序或参数生成模块，这些方法要么限制了可行权衡的范围，要么带来高昂的训练和推理成本。模型合并通过参数组合的方式复用多个面向特定目标的模型，提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，由于缺乏共享的线性区域以及跨目标的参数干扰，将其直接应用于推荐系统面临挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了RecSoup，一种通过专门化模型合并实现有效CMOR的轻量级两阶段方法。RecSoup首先通过剪枝策略缓解跨目标的参数干扰……
tldr: 提出RecSoup，一种基于专门化模型合并的轻量级两阶段方法，通过剪枝策略缓解跨目标参数干扰，实现无需重新训练即可在推理时动态调整目标权衡的可控多目标推荐。
en_tdlr: RecSoup is a lightweight two-stage approach based on specialized model merging that mitigates cross-objective parameter interference via pruning, enabling controllable multi-objective recommendation with dynamic trade-off adjustment at inference time without retraining.
